entries.title: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
entries.snippet: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

entries.title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
entries.snippet: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

entries.title: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
entries.snippet: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

entries.title: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
entries.snippet: Scientists say the record-breaking journey by three brothers offers hope wildlife can survive growing pressures.

entries.title: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
entries.snippet: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

entries.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
entries.snippet: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

entries.title: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
entries.snippet: The killing of the 16-year-old nearly a year ago had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about social media.

entries.title: Immigrants held in small outdoor cages at 'Alligator Alcatraz' in Florida, investigators find
entries.snippet: DHS inspectors say they found the immigration-detention centre violated basic standards for hygiene, medical care, food and safety.

entries.title: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
entries.snippet: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote says he wants ordinary people to share in the success of his oil refinery.

entries.title: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
entries.snippet: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Four other women's bodies have been found nearby.

entries.title: Zambians warned not to eat dead wildlife after anthrax kills dozens of animals
entries.snippet: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.

entries.title: Hyrox apologises for allowing race to continue after athlete soils herself
entries.snippet: Some raised concerns around hygiene while others praised the competitor's resolve to finish the race and push through adversity.

entries.title: Trump says he will remove all Irish whiskey tariffs as he ends two-day visit
entries.snippet: Whiskey distilled in the Republic of Ireland faces the standard 15% tariff which applies to EU goods entering the US.

entries.title: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
entries.snippet: Ships and helicopters are searching for those missing from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.

entries.title: Bali police investigate after Australian man and children found dead in home
entries.snippet: Police were called after the man's wife became concerned and asked neighbours to check on her family.

entries.title: Turkish police detain dozens in raids on gay bars and homes of LGBTQ+ activists
entries.snippet: Human rights groups in Turkey have accused the government of using a family- values campaign to target the LGBTQ+ community.

entries.title: Iran war reshapes Brics ties but also exposes divisions
entries.snippet: Brics members agree they need a new global order but it's harder to answer what should replace it and how to get there.

entries.title: Legendary Canadian boxer George Chuvalo dies aged 89
entries.snippet: The heavyweight champion took on the likes of Muhammad Ali and Joe Frazier, and was known for never once getting knocked out or knocked down.

entries.title: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake
entries.snippet: The small plane carrying Rep Tom Tiffany had a mechanical issue that forced the pilot to make an emergency landing on a Wisconsin lake.

entries.title: They lost their jobs after posting about Charlie Kirk, but some have no regrets
entries.snippet: Some people fired in the wake of Kirk's assassination have won big settlements from employers, others have had to start over from scratch.

entries.title: See who's won an Emmy Award so far
entries.snippet: Law & Order: SVU star Mariska Hargitay is hosting the Emmy Awards on Monday night. We'll be updating this list as winners are announced.

entries.title: The Supreme Court rejects Trump's mail voting restrictions for this year's midterms
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court has rejected the Trump administration's request to allow mail-in voting restrictions under a U.S. Postal Service plan for the midterm general election.

entries.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate after fall that led to an extended medical absence
entries.snippet: McConnell spent weeks in recovery before explaining he was "briefly unconscious" following the fall that sent him to the hospital and a weeks-long recovery process.

entries.title: Federal agents may have broken state laws in voter fraud hunt, whistleblower claims
entries.snippet: Federal agents may have broken state laws after the Department of Homeland Security began surging personnel for what it called the Unlawful Voter Initiative, a federal whistleblower alleges.

entries.title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
entries.snippet: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.

entries.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
entries.snippet: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

entries.title: 10 years after taking a knee, Colin Kaepernick is still waging a 'Perilous Fight'
entries.snippet: The former 49ers quarterback created an uproar in 2016 when took a knee during the national anthem to protest police brutality. In The Perilous Fight he explains why he still wants to play football.

entries.title: Kennedy Center says it's on the brink of bankruptcy, might close as early as Tuesday
entries.snippet: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state — and that only President Trump can "rescue" it.

entries.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
entries.snippet: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

entries.snippet: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

entries.title: Mahmoud Khalil lawsuit says Columbia University failed to protect pro-Palestinian activists
entries.snippet: The university's "deliberate indifference" led to the doxing of multiple group members and Khalil's detention by immigration agents, according to the civil rights lawsuit filed in federal court in New York City.

entries.snippet: Republican Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky has returned to the Senate after a long absence. The 94-year-old senator has not been to the U.S. Capitol since June 14, when he was hospitalized for a fall in his home.

entries.snippet: Experts say that the drop is a cause for worry, and that it's unlikely that the need for food assistance has dropped.

entries.title: Turkish authorities launch crackdown on LGBTQ+ and HIV support groups
entries.snippet: Turkish authorities cracked down on multiple LGBTQ+ groups and individuals early Sunday morning, detaining dozens of members, breaking into association offices and raiding popular hangouts.

entries.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine will pause strikes on Russia if Kremlin spares critical infrastructure
entries.snippet: His comments Monday follow President Donald Trump's claim that Russia and Ukraine agreed not to target each other's energy infrastructure.

entries.title: Pope celebrates his 71st birthday but it's Vatican employees who get the gift
entries.snippet: The Vatican published a papal decree repealing 2021 salary cuts that Pope Francis had imposed on many Vatican employees as part of the Holy See's COVID-19 cost-saving measures.

entries.title: Man pleads not guilty in the hanging death of Tasia Fortune in Mississippi
entries.snippet: A man charged with murder in the hanging of a Black woman in Mississippi pleaded not guilty Monday at his first court appearance.

entries.title: Houthis seize 2 strategic Red Sea islands, and other Mideast developments
entries.snippet: Yemen's Houthi rebels have seized the strategic islands of Greater and Lesser Hanish in the southern Red Sea. This move strengthens their control over a key maritime shipping route.

entries.title: After decades of insurgency, Muslim region in Philippines votes in its first parliamentary election
entries.snippet: The vote on Monday marks a crucial step toward self-rule after decades of insurgency in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Patel testifies on FBI oversight before Senate panel amid troubled tenure
entries.snippet: FBI Director Kash Patel is set to appear before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Tuesday for an oversight hearing on the nation's lead law enforcement agency.

entries.title: Live Results: Delaware midterm primaries
entries.snippet: Delaware's Democratic U.S. senator, U.S. representative and state attorney general will go before voters in a state primary Tuesday as they seek reelection.

entries.title: Some Democrats recalibrating approach to transgender issues
entries.snippet: An increasing number of Democratic leaders have begun to push back against their party's unflinching support for the transgender community this midterm season.

entries.title: Some Russians flee country, citing Ukraine war draft fears and loss of freedoms
entries.snippet: Some Russians have left the country this year amid rumors of a new mobilization of troops for the war in Ukraine as well as a crackdown on their personal freedoms.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has urged his party to stay disciplined as pressure grows over his leadership. Meanwhile, Germany's homeownership rate has fallen to its lowest level in 20 years. DW has the latest.

entries.title: Kremlin-linked Russian oligarch helped fund Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration
entries.snippet: Trump's son and his wife confirmed reports that Umar Kremlev paid for parts of the festivities. Kremlev was awarded the "Order of Friendship" by Putin earlier this year.

entries.title: Arctic power plays: EU searches for a new strategy
entries.snippet: Russia’s aggression, Trump’s threats against Greenland and the race for critical raw materials are pushing the Arctic to the top of Europe’s agenda.

entries.title: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
entries.snippet: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.

entries.title: Trump seeks halt to energy attacks by both Russia, Ukraine
entries.snippet: Donald Trump, under fire for record US diesel prices, claims Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop striking energy targets. Russia said nothing; Ukraine said "we expect specifics from our partners" on any such move.

entries.title: Donald Trump dismisses concerns about dangers of AI
entries.snippet: The president called efforts to slow the development of artificial intelligence a "sick conspiracy," claiming they only serve China. Market leaders have warned of the dangers of the pace of the technology's development.

entries.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
entries.snippet: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have tightened their grip on a key shipping route, capturing two strategic Red Sea islands. The closure of another global transport route is the latest ripple effect of the US war with Iran.

entries.title: Women's Basketball World Cup: Can Germany harness a boom?
entries.snippet: Germany thrilled fans at the Women's Basketball World Cup. But even if this sparked a boom in the women's game, the infrastructure simply isn't ready for it.

entries.title: IPO 'for the people' is out of reach for many in Nigeria
entries.snippet: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?

entries.title: Ukraine: AfD questions German aid, Berlin remains committed
entries.snippet: Emboldened by its win in Saxony-Anhalt, the far-right Alternative for Germany wants the government to change its Ukraine and Russia policies. Berlin is staying the course, but support is fading — especially in the east.

entries.title: The Crusades: How a medieval Holy War still shapes politics
entries.snippet: In 1095, the Catholic Church launched the Crusades: wars that left millions dead and whose legacy still shapes political and ideological conflicts.

entries.title: Nepal: thousands still missing as flood recovery begins
entries.snippet: The Himalayan nation is moving from rescue operations to recovery, facing a $4.8 billion reconstruction bill amid renewed calls for climate justice.

entries.title: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
entries.snippet: Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.

entries.title: Berlin businesswoman charged with spying for Russia
entries.snippet: Prosecutors say the Berlin marketing executive used her political and military contacts to help a Russian intelligence officer gain access to influential circles and seek information on German defense policy.

entries.title: India women's team refuse Asia Cup cricket trophy from Pakistan minister
entries.snippet: After beating Sri Lanka to win a record eighth Asia Cup title, the Indian women's cricket team skipped the trophy presentation with Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi.

entries.title: Pay to ghost your boss: Japan's resignation business
entries.snippet: Resignation agencies in Japan help employees leave their jobs seamlessly in just 15 minutes. Young people are especially eager to use their services.

entries.title: Israeli minister accuses 'NAZA' filmmakers of 'treason'
entries.snippet: Israel's culture minister wants to strip the makers of a documentary on Israel's Gaza offensive of their citizenship. He accused the two of seeking "applause from antisemites around the world."

entries.title: Finland: EU leaders meet to forge new Arctic policy
entries.snippet: European leaders are meeting over shipping, resources and security in the region amid pressure from the US, China and Russia. The EU sees the Arctic as key to its future security as melting ice makes it more accessible.

entries.title: North Korea says recent drill shows 'huge destructive power'
entries.snippet: North Korea carried out a coordinated live-fire exercise involving multiple weapons systems over the weekend. The drill came after the US, South Korea and Japan wrapped up five days of joint maritime exercises.
